floorPlans.note: The figure beside the selector is the saleable area of the home. The original sheet lists the plot area separately. Confirm both figures for the specific villa.

review.images: 6 native developer renders from the named The Terraces brochure pages. The three exterior scenes come from the project’s garden-villa section. The living, bedroom and dining renders are from its own interiors section.
review.location: The complete physical page 27 marks the enclave separately from the rest of Sobha City. The road corridor and Al Bahiya are from Sobha’s 11 April 2026 release (https://sobharealty.com/media-center/press-releases/sobha-city-abu-dhabis-new-nature-led-waterfront-living-community). Five existing destinations use the official project page’s approximate community journeys. The proposed theme park is outside the existing destinations shown here.
review.floorPlans: 12 full original sheets, including distinct mirrored designs and their own plot ranges. The displayed saleable area was read from the visible panel on every sheet. Plot area remains visible on the source.
